dedupe_keys.name: mobile service coverage by operator and populated centre osiptel peru

description: This dataset lists mobile service coverage and the number of base stations at populated-centre level, as declared quarterly by the mobile operators to the Peruvian regulator. Contents: populated centres by department, province and district with INEI Ubigeo codes and latitude and longitude, and the number of base stations able to provide coverage by 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G technologies, with voice, SMS, MMS and mobile internet at speeds of up to 1 Mbps and above 1 Mbps as declared. Some centres have declared coverage but no base stations, because rural areas are often served by macro stations on high ground reaching nearby settlements. Producer: OSIPTEL, published on the Plataforma Nacional de Datos Abiertos. Coverage: Peru, at populated-centre level. Access: a CSV download with a data dictionary in XLSX and metadata in PDF; no login is required. Licence and cost: Open Data Commons Attribution License and free. Caveats: coverage is declared by the operators, not measured, and base station counts do not show individual site locations. Simulation uses: it supports coverage gap analysis, rural capacity planning and exposure of unserved settlements to hazards. Related record: OpenCellID (data-opencellid), a crowdsourced source of measured cell locations for comparison.
